semiconductor_relevance: High — GRIKIN Advanced Materials specializes in ultra-high purity metal targets and evaporation materials essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: GRIKIN Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of PVD thin-film materials in China, focusing on the development, production, and sales of ultra-high purity metal targets and evaporation materials for integrated circuits. The company operates as a vertically integrated platform, ensuring quality from raw material purification to final product fabrication.
capabilities: Ultra-high purity metal targets for PVD processes

regional_presence.China: GRIKIN is headquartered in China and operates two wholly-owned subsidiaries within the country.
